description: An ET41 with 25 loaded coal wagons (412W, 60 t each, G; about 1670 t) on a line of its own beside td.scn: up a gradient of 10 per mille to the signal hu_sem1 1000 m up, at stop until 10:42, where it stops with the whole train on the gradient; when the signal clears, it is to start without rolling back and get away, to the signal at stop 2300 m up (#265, #187).
